body_lead: Odisha introduces AI course for apprenticeship degree students The course aims to equip students with basic AI knowledge and practical skills to improve their employability and prepare them for industry apprenticeships. Odisha will introduce 'AI for All' as a value-added course for students enrolled in the Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme (AEDP), replacing the Good Citizenship course in the second semester of the 2026-27 academic session, an official said on Thursday.
